name: admin-leads
doc: The shared lead dashboard on accounts' /admin/leads (the owner, 2026-11-08: "make the shared lead dashboard be in the admin dashboard, not in one of the products"). Toran keeps the outreach and talks to Teder about the same store (its src/ops/leadsAdmin.ts, tederLeads.ts); accounts shows one list for both products and one page a lead, and every button is handed to Toran. The other buttons of a lead (they answered, the next step, later, not interested, a customer) are toran-ops' POST /internal/ops/<toran|teder>/<id>/<action>, as on the dashboard. A demo's state is none, building, review (built, waiting for the operator's look), ready (up, its pageUrl set), failed or removed; where is new, ready, sent, talking or closed. ok false is a refusal in Toran's own words (error, in Hebrew), which accounts shows as it is.
